One thing I’ve always wanted in more apps, so I added it to #Cue:

Move tools and navigation to where they work best for you — bottom, left, or right.

Different screen sizes, different ways of holding a device, different workflows. The most useful controls shouldn’t have to live in the same place for everyone.


#iOS #automationtools #buildinpublic #indiedev #productivity #accessibility
